Slaying.name: Slaying
Slaying.description: Channels inner strength into a powerful strike.

Thrusting.name: Thrusting
Thrusting.description: A piercing sword strike that ignores the secondary target’s Defence.

HalfMoon.name: Half Moon
HalfMoon.description: Sweeps enemies in a frontal arc with sword energy.

FlamingSword.name: Flaming Sword
FlamingSword.description: Charges your next strike with fire.

LionRoar.name: Lion Roar
LionRoar.description: Unleashes a roar that paralyses eligible nearby enemies.

FireBall.name: Fire Ball
FireBall.description: Hurls a fireball at one enemy. Damage grows with skill rank.

ElectricShock.name: Electric Shock
ElectricShock.description: Attempts to tame eligible monsters as allies. See the rank details for level limits.

GreatFireBall.name: Great Fire Ball
GreatFireBall.description: Hurls a powerful fireball. Damage grows with skill rank.

ThunderBolt.name: Thunder Bolt
ThunderBolt.description: Calls down lightning to strike an enemy.

FireBang.name: Fire Bang
FireBang.description: Engulfs a small area around the target in intense flames.

FireWall.name: Fire Wall
FireWall.description: Creates a wall of fire that burns enemies who enter it.

FrostCrunch.name: Frost Crunch
FrostCrunch.description: Launches a ball of ice that can freeze enemies. Frozen enemies take more fire damage.

ThunderStorm.name: Thunder Storm
ThunderStorm.description: Strikes surrounding enemies with a lightning storm, dealing the most damage at its centre.

MagicShield.name: Magic Shield
MagicShield.description: Creates a protective shield whose strength and duration increase with skill rank. Advanced ranks limit single-hit damage and can negate damage at low HP.
MagicShield.rank.4.desc.2: Caps damage per hit at 50% of Max HP
MagicShield.rank.5.desc.2: Caps damage per hit at 45% of Max HP
MagicShield.rank.6.desc.2: Caps damage per hit at 40% of Max HP

IceStorm.name: Ice Storm
IceStorm.description: Calls an ice storm over the target area.

FlameDisruptor.name: Flame Disruptor
FlameDisruptor.description: Strikes a single enemy with dragon fire, ignoring part of its Magic Defence.

MeteorStrike.name: Meteor Strike
MeteorStrike.description: Calls repeated meteor strikes on enemies locked within the casting area.

Healing.name: Healing
Healing.description: Restore your health or an owned summon’s health. On desktop, hover your summon to heal it; an enemy or empty ground heals yourself. On mobile, select your summon then tap the skill.

SpiritSword.name: Spirit Sword
SpiritSword.description: Focuses spiritual power to improve Accuracy.

Poisoning.name: Poisoning
Poisoning.description: Poisons enemies, reduces their Defence and prevents automatic HP recovery. On desktop, poison the enemy monster under the cursor without locking on first. With no monster under the cursor, do not cast. Mobile keeps touch targeting.

SoulFireBall.name: Soul Fire Ball
SoulFireBall.description: Strikes an enemy with a spirit talisman. Advanced ranks ignore part of its defence.

SummonSkeleton.name: Summon Skeleton
SummonSkeleton.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 Skeleton companions, starting at level 1
SummonSkeleton.rank.2.desc.1: Summons 1 Skeleton companions, starting at level 2
SummonSkeleton.rank.3.desc.1: Summons 2 Skeleton companions, starting at level 3

Hiding.name: Hiding
Hiding.description: Conceals you from monsters for a time. Duration scales with skill rank and Taoism.

SummonShinsu.name: Summon Shinsu
SummonShinsu.description: Summons a powerful, fire-breathing Shinsu companion.
SummonShinsu.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 Shinsu companions, starting at level 1
SummonShinsu.rank.2.desc.1: Summons 1 Shinsu companions, starting at level 2
SummonShinsu.rank.3.desc.1: Summons 2 Shinsu companions, starting at level 3

PoisonCloud.name: Poison Cloud
PoisonCloud.description: Spreads a cloud that deals repeated damage to enemies in an area and may poison them.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Reduces the chance of flinching when hit.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description: Improves weapon mastery and attack effectiveness.

BlazingSword.name: Blazing Sword
BlazingSword.description: Unleashes fire-charged sword energy along a line ahead.

SkyCleaver.name: Sky Cleaver
SkyCleaver.description: Strikes enemies in a straight line with sword energy.

BloodDragon.name: Blood Dragon
BloodDragon.description: Increases Attack Speed and critical-hit chance.

DiamondBody.name: Diamond Body
DiamondBody.description: Uses inner energy to absorb or reflect damage. Advanced training increases Max HP and Health Potion recovery.

WhirlwindSlash.name: Whirlwind Slash
WhirlwindSlash.description: Sweeps all surrounding enemies with twin sword arcs and may briefly stun lower-level foes.

FlashSlash.name: Flash Slash
FlashSlash.description: Dashes forward with an explosive strike.
FlashSlash.rank.1.desc.1: Attacks all enemies within 2 tiles ahead
FlashSlash.rank.2.desc.1: Attacks all enemies within 3 tiles ahead
FlashSlash.rank.3.desc.1: Attacks all enemies within 4 tiles ahead

IceFlame.name: Ice Flame
IceFlame.description: Attacks enemies with pillars of ice.

DragonFlame.name: Dragon Flame
DragonFlame.description: Scorches enemies within an area over time.

Abyss.name: Abyss
Abyss.description: Increases magic damage at the cost of higher MP consumption.

ChainThunder.name: Chain Thunder
ChainThunder.description: Sends powerful lightning leaping between enemies.

AdvancedSummon.name: Advanced Summon
AdvancedSummon.description: Summons a powerful, fire-breathing Ancient Shinsu companion.
AdvancedSummon.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 Ancient Shinsu companions, starting at level 1
AdvancedSummon.rank.2.desc.1: Summons 1 Ancient Shinsu companions, starting at level 2
AdvancedSummon.rank.3.desc.1: Summons 2 Ancient Shinsu companions, starting at level 3

BeastArmour.name: Beast Armour
BeastArmour.description: Enhances an Ancient Shinsu’s combat stats.

InnateQi.name: Innate Qi
InnateQi.description: Gradually restores HP after taking damage and strengthens soul-element spells.
InnateQi.rank.1.desc.1: Restores 10% of damage taken as HP over time
InnateQi.rank.2.desc.1: Restores 20% of damage taken as HP over time
InnateQi.rank.3.desc.1: Restores 30% of damage taken as HP over time
InnateQi.rank.4.desc.1: Restores 40% of damage taken as HP over time
InnateQi.rank.5.desc.1: Restores 50% of damage taken as HP over time
InnateQi.rank.6.desc.1: Restores 60% of damage taken as HP over time

SummonTiger.name: Summon Tiger
SummonTiger.description: Summons a powerful White Tiger companion.
SummonTiger.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 White Tiger companions, starting at level 1
SummonTiger.rank.2.desc.1: Summons 1 White Tiger companions, starting at level 2
SummonTiger.rank.3.desc.1: Summons 2 White Tiger companions, starting at level 3
SummonTiger.rank.4.desc.1: Summons 1 Empowered White Tiger companions, starting at level 1
SummonTiger.rank.5.desc.1: Summons 1 Empowered White Tiger companions, starting at level 2
SummonTiger.rank.6.desc.1: Summons 2 Empowered White Tiger companions, starting at level 3

SummonMoonSpirit.name: Summon Moon Spirit
SummonMoonSpirit.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 Moon Spirit companions, starting at level 1
SummonMoonSpirit.rank.2.desc.1: Summons 1 Moon Spirit companions, starting at level 2
SummonMoonSpirit.rank.3.desc.1: Summons 2 Moon Spirit companions, starting at level 3

SummonSpiritServant.name: Summon Spirit Servant
SummonSpiritServant.description: Summons a spirit with ranged talisman attacks. Attack and defence scale with owner Taoism. Shares the basic summon slot with Skeleton. Shares owner experience while present, up to level 7. Living re-summons and saves retain growth; death resets level and XP. After 5 seconds out of combat, restores 1% max HP every 5 seconds. Hover your spirit on desktop, or select it on mobile, then cast Healing. Receive the book after First Steps and learn it from your bag; no upgrade books required
SummonSpiritServant.rank.1.desc.1: Summons 1 Spirit Servant with a 2-tile attack range; it holds its ground in melee
SummonSpiritServant.rank.1.desc.2: Inherits 60% Taoism as Attack, 25% physical and 20% magic defence, and twice average Taoism as HP
SummonSpiritServant.rank.1.desc.3: Receive the book after First Steps and learn it from your bag; no upgrade books required
SummonSpiritServant.rank.1.desc.4: Shares owner experience while present, up to level 7. Living re-summons and saves retain growth; death resets level and XP. After 5 seconds out of combat, restores 1% max HP every 5 seconds. Select your spirit to heal it with Healing.

HeavyStrike.name: Heavy Strike
HeavyStrike.description: Every fourth damaging normal melee hit deals 150% damage. Resets after 8 seconds without a hit. Replaced when Slaying is learned.
HeavyStrike.rank.1.desc.1: Every fourth damaging normal melee hit deals 150% damage. Resets after 8 seconds without a hit. Replaced when Slaying is learned.
